name: mech-royale
description: Bot for the mechfight/1 16-mech battle royale. Runs on Node 24 with no runtime dependencies.

scripts.typecheck: DENO_DIR=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/deno deno check bot test sim tools
scripts.check:docker: python3 mechfight-kit/check/check.py --map-dir /arena -- docker run --rm -i --platform linux/amd64 --network none --cpus 1 --memory 512m --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=64m --user 65534:65534 -v "$PWD/mechfight-kit/arena:/arena:ro" mech-royale
scripts.verify: node --run typecheck && node --run test && node --run check && node --run docker:build && node --run check:docker
